name: Tao APK

on:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'nhat-ky.txt'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Chuan bi va build
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set +e
          exec > >(tee -a "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/nhat-ky.txt") 2>&1

          echo "===== 1. MOI TRUONG ====="
          date -u
          java -version
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
          echo "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
          SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}"
          echo "SDK=$SDK"
          echo "--- platforms co san ---"
          ls "$SDK/platforms" 2>&1
          echo "--- build-tools co san ---"
          ls "$SDK/build-tools" 2>&1
          echo "--- cmdline-tools ---"
          ls "$SDK/cmdline-tools" 2>&1

          echo "===== 2. CAI THEM SDK NEU THIEU ====="
          SDKM=""
          for p in "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" \
                   "$SDK/cmdline-tools/bin/sdkmanager" \
                   "$SDK/tools/bin/sdkmanager"; do
            if [ -x "$p" ]; then SDKM="$p"; break; fi
          done
          echo "sdkmanager: ${SDKM:-KHONG TIM THAY}"
          if [ -n "$SDKM" ] && [ ! -d "$SDK/platforms/android-36" ]; then
            yes | "$SDKM" --licenses > /dev/null 2>&1
            "$SDKM" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" 2>&1 | tail -5
            echo "ket qua cai dat: $?"
          else
            echo "Da co android-36 hoac khong can cai."
          fi
          ls "$SDK/platforms" 2>&1

          echo "===== 3. GIAI NEN MA NGUON ====="
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          ls -la
          F=$(ls *.zip 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          echo "File nen: $F"
          if [ -z "$F" ]; then echo "LOI: khong tim thay file .zip"; exit 1; fi
          unzip -q -o "$F" -d nguon
          echo "unzip xong, ma tra ve $?"
          D=$(find nguon -maxdepth 3 -name settings.gradle -printf '%h\n' | head -1)
          echo "Thu muc du an: $D"
          if [ -z "$D" ]; then echo "LOI: khong tim thay settings.gradle"; find nguon -maxdepth 3; exit 1; fi
          ls -la "$D"

          echo "===== 4. BIEN DICH ====="
          cd "$D"
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleTructiepRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace
          RC=$?
          echo "===== KET QUA GRADLE: $RC ====="

          echo "===== 5. TIM FILE APK ====="
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          find . -name "*.apk" -not -path "./.git/*" 2>/dev/null
          mkdir -p out
          A=$(find . -name "*release*.apk" -not -path "./.git/*" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          echo "APK: ${A:-KHONG CO}"
          if [ -n "$A" ]; then
            cp "$A" out/LichViaPhat.apk
            ls -la out
            echo "===== THANH CONG ====="
          else
            echo "===== THAT BAI: khong tao duoc APK ====="
          fi

      - name: Luu nhat ky vao kho de xem loi
        if: always()
        run: |
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          if [ -f nhat-ky.txt ]; then
            tail -c 300000 nhat-ky.txt > nk.tmp && mv nk.tmp nhat-ky.txt
            git config user.name "github-actions"
            git config user.email "actions@github.com"
            git add -f nhat-ky.txt
            git commit -m "nhat ky build lan ${{ github.run_number }} [skip ci]" || true
            git pull --rebase --autostash || true
            git push || true
          fi

      - name: Tao ban phat hanh
        if: hashFiles('out/LichViaPhat.apk') != ''
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: apk-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: Lich Via Phat - ban ${{ github.run_number }}
          body: "Tinh That A Di Da - Chau Doc. Bam vao LichViaPhat.apk ben duoi de tai va cai."
          files: out/LichViaPhat.apk
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
